    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AIManager
    Represents the AI bot for our game.
    Animation
    Represents the animation and movement of the players and the ball.
    Ball
    Represents the ball for our game.
    Button
    Class for managing the buttons
    Court
    Court class for our game.
    DefenseManager
    Defense manager class for managing the defensive modifiers.
    Drawable
    Interface for objects that can be drawn allows us to use a for each loop to draw all the objects
    GamePanel
    Main gameplay panel.
    HoopDuels
    This is the HoopDuel class It manages the window frame and the classes connected to it.

    This is the welcome screen after the name screen.

    This is the first screen and it asks the user for the name
    Play
    This is the class for the individual plays in the game.
    Player
    Represents the individual players in HoopDuel.
    PlayerManager
    Player manager class that manages the player data Utility class
    PlayLog
    This is the playlog class, draws the play log and logs events that happen.
    PlayManager
    Play manager class that manages the players.
    PostGamePanel
    Game Panel for when the game ends
    ScoreBoard
    This is the class for scoreboard.
    ShotCalculator
    This is a utility class that calculates whether a shot is made or missed.
    StartingFivePanel
    This is the starting five panel where users can choose the 5 players they want.
    Team
    This is the team class and stores data such as name, field goal scores and attempts
    TeamSelectionPanel
    this is the panel for team selection.
